story: You are a researcher at the University of California, Berkeley, conducting a longitudinal study called 'Educational Pathways and Outcomes.' You are collecting data on various aspects of student life, including their gender, grade level, parental education, school type, attendance rates, test scores, class sizes, and more. This comprehensive dataset aims to understand how different factors influence educational outcomes and career choices.
